title: Vendor Agreement
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Parties

This Agreement is entered into between Silvestrix Green LLP, an India-registered limited liability partnership trading as PlantAtHome ("PlantAtHome"), and the nursery, grower, manufacturer or supplier identified in the executed onboarding record ("Vendor").

Definitions

"Platform" means the PlantAtHome storefront, mobile applications and vendor console. "Listing" means a Vendor product published for sale. "Hyperlocal Order" means an order fulfilled by same-day rider in a serviceable city; "Courier Order" means an order shipped pan-India. "Configuration" means the operational parameters approved by PlantAtHome management and published in the vendor console, which govern all timelines and commercial rates referenced here.

Appointment

PlantAtHome appoints the Vendor as a non-exclusive approved supplier. No agency, partnership, franchise or employment relationship is created, and neither party may bind the other.

Scope

The Vendor supplies live plants, pots and planters, gardening tools, seeds, fertilizers, accessories, FarmBox produce or corporate gifting items as approved category-by-category during onboarding. Categories not expressly approved may not be listed.

Vendor Responsibilities

The Vendor maintains current KYC, GST and trade licence records, keeps Listing content accurate, honours accepted orders, staffs pickup windows, and responds to PlantAtHome operations queries within {{support_response_sla}}.

PlantAtHome Responsibilities

PlantAtHome operates the Platform and vendor console, markets the catalogue, collects customer payments, arranges rider or courier capacity, provides customer support, and settles Vendor dues on the {{vendor_settlement_cycle}}.

Product Requirements

Products must be genuine, lawfully sourced, free of quarantine pests, and compliant with applicable Indian law including plant quarantine, seed, insecticide, legal metrology and packaged commodity rules. Restricted or invasive species may not be listed.

Quality Standards

Live plants must be dispatched healthy, rooted, hydrated and true to the listed species, size and pot specification. Photographs must depict the actual grade supplied, not aspirational stock imagery.

Inventory Accuracy

The Vendor keeps stock counts current in the vendor console. Cancellations caused by stock the Vendor did not hold are treated as Vendor-attributable failures under Performance Standards.

Pricing

The Vendor sets its supply price. PlantAtHome sets the customer-facing retail price, city-level margins, promotions and the {{free_shipping_threshold}} at its discretion; margin changes do not alter agreed supply prices for orders already accepted.

Order Acceptance

Routed orders must be accepted or rejected with reason within {{vendor_acceptance_sla}}. Unactioned orders may be auto-rejected and rerouted to another vendor.

Packaging

Packaging must protect root balls, retain moisture, immobilise pots and survive the applicable transit mode. Vendor branding, contact details and competing marketing material may not be inserted.

Dispatch

Accepted orders must be packed, labelled with the PlantAtHome-generated label and handed over within {{vendor_dispatch_sla}}. Hyperlocal handovers occur at the assigned rider window.

Delivery Cooperation

The Vendor cooperates with assigned delivery partners across {{delivery_sla_hyperlocal}} and {{delivery_sla_courier}} lanes, supports the configured {{delivery_attempts}}, and accepts return-leg pickups where the Vendor is the return destination.

Returns

Customer returns are governed by the published customer policy, including the {{return_request_window}} and the {{live_plant_claim_window}} for perishable goods. The Vendor accepts returned goods routed to it and cooperates with condition assessment.

Replacements

Where evidence submitted within the {{replacement_evidence_window}} shows damage, disease or mis-supply attributable to the Vendor, the Vendor supplies a replacement or bears the refund value at PlantAtHome's election.

Settlement

Payouts run on the {{vendor_settlement_cycle}}, net of commission, penalties, refunds and chargebacks. Settlement disputes must be raised within {{vendor_settlement_dispute_window}} of the statement date.

Fees and Commission

Commission is charged on the {{commission_model}} as recorded in the vendor console. Rate changes take effect prospectively after notice through the console.

Taxes

The Vendor is responsible for its own GST registration, correct HSN classification, tax invoicing within {{gst_invoice_timeline}}, and filing. PlantAtHome deducts TDS and TCS where statutorily required.

Confidentiality

Each party protects the other's non-public commercial, pricing, technical and customer information, and uses it solely to perform this Agreement.

Intellectual Property

Each party retains its own marks and content. The Vendor grants PlantAtHome a licence to use submitted product content for catalogue and marketing purposes; the Vendor may not use PlantAtHome branding without written approval.

Data Protection

The Vendor processes personal data only on PlantAtHome's instructions, applies reasonable security safeguards, retains such data no longer than {{data_retention_period}}, and supports data subject requests within {{dsr_response_time}}.

Customer Information

Customer names, addresses and contact details are disclosed strictly for fulfilment. Direct solicitation, off-platform selling, remarketing or resale of customer data is prohibited.

Prohibited Conduct

Prohibited conduct includes counterfeit or misdescribed goods, review manipulation, false stock, diversion of Platform customers, and misuse of Platform access credentials.

Performance Standards

StandardMeasure
Order acceptance{{vendor_acceptance_sla}}
Dispatch and handover{{vendor_dispatch_sla}}
Condition and accuracy on arrival{{vendor_quality_target}}
Vendor-attributable returnsBelow {{vendor_return_rate_threshold}}
Inventory accuracy and cancellationsAs per the currently approved Inventory Configuration
Review cadence{{review_frequency_default}}

Penalties

Breaches of the standards above attract deductions under the {{penalty_schedule}}, applied against the next settlement with itemised reasons visible in the vendor console.

Suspension

PlantAtHome may suspend Listings, order routing or console access for lapsed KYC, quality or safety risk, suspected fraud, or sustained failure against Performance Standards, pending investigation.

Termination

Either party may terminate for convenience on written notice as configured, or immediately for material breach, insolvency or unlawful conduct. Accepted orders must be completed and final settlement follows the normal cycle.

Liability

The Vendor indemnifies PlantAtHome against claims arising from defective, unlawful or misdescribed goods and from its own breach. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss; PlantAtHome's aggregate liability is limited to amounts payable to the Vendor in the preceding settlement cycles, as configured.

Dispute Resolution

Disputes are first escalated through the vendor operations channel per the {{escalation_timeline}}; unresolved matters proceed to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seated in India at the location recorded in the onboarding record.

Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of India, and courts at the stated seat have exclusive jurisdiction subject to the arbitration clause.

General Clauses

This Agreement, the onboarding record and the published Configuration form the entire agreement. The Vendor may not assign it without consent. Invalid provisions are severed; a waiver on one occasion is not a continuing waiver. Notices are valid when sent to the registered console and email addresses on record.

Related Documents

  • Vendor Onboarding and KYC Policy
  • Vendor Performance and Penalty Standard
  • Vendor Settlement and Payout SOP
  • Packaging and Dispatch SOP
  • Returns, Refunds and Replacement Policy

title: Terms and Conditions
related_titles: Live Plant Health and Replacement Policy
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Purpose

These Terms and Conditions govern the sale of live plants, gardening tools, pots and planters, seeds, fertilizers, accessories, FarmBox fresh produce and corporate gifting by Silvestrix Green LLP, trading as PlantAtHome, to customers in India. They state what a customer may expect from an order, what PlantAtHome expects from a customer, and — because living goods are never identical to one another — how plant appearance is judged fairly.

Scope

These Terms apply to every order placed through the PlantAtHome website, mobile application, WhatsApp Business channel or an authorised PlantAtHome representative, whether the order is fulfilled from PlantAtHome's own stock or by an approved nursery vendor, and whether it is delivered by hyperlocal rider or by pan-India courier. Where a corporate gifting or bulk supply order is covered by a separately signed agreement, that agreement prevails over these Terms to the extent of any conflict.

Definitions

  • Customer — the person or entity placing an order, including a guest checkout user.
  • Order — a request to purchase listed items, treated as an offer until PlantAtHome confirms acceptance.
  • Vendor — an approved nursery or supplier fulfilling an order on PlantAtHome's behalf.
  • Live Goods — plants, saplings, cuttings, bulbs and FarmBox produce, being perishable living material.
  • Natural Variation — differences in shape, size, colour, foliage density, branching habit and growth stage between individual specimens of the same species and grade.
  • Configuration — the operational parameters (windows, thresholds and service timelines) approved by management and maintained in PlantAtHome's commerce settings; this document references the Configuration instead of fixed figures.

Policy Statement

By placing an order or using PlantAtHome's channels, the customer accepts these Terms. An order is an offer; a sale contract is formed only when PlantAtHome issues an order confirmation, and PlantAtHome may decline or cancel an order before that point for stock, serviceability, pricing-error or risk reasons. The sale contract is with Silvestrix Green LLP even when a vendor physically ships the goods. Live Goods are supplied healthy, true to the named species and to the listed grade. Natural Variation is expected and is not a defect — but Natural Variation is never a defence for supplying unhealthy, pest-infested, damaged, dying or mislabelled stock.

Responsibilities

  • Customer — accurate contact and address details, availability at delivery, unboxing of Live Goods on arrival, and honest claims.
  • Catalogue team — listings that describe species, grade, pot size and growth stage as they will be at dispatch.
  • Vendor operations — enforcing vendor acceptance within {{vendor_acceptance_sla}} and dispatch within {{vendor_dispatch_sla}}, and rejecting sub-grade stock at pack-out.
  • Customer support — acknowledging contacts within {{support_response_sla}} and closing within {{support_resolution_sla}}.
  • Finance — invoicing, refund approval within {{refund_approval_sla}} and disbursement within {{refund_processing_time}}.

Policy Requirements

Eligibility and accounts

Customers must be capable of contracting under the Indian Contract Act, 1872; minors may transact only through a parent or guardian. Registration requires a verifiable mobile number. The customer is responsible for activity under their account and must not share OTPs or login credentials. PlantAtHome may suspend an account showing fraud, abuse or repeated undeliverable orders.

Products, images and availability

Descriptions, heights and pot sizes are indicative of the grade supplied at dispatch. Photographs are representative of the species and grade; they may show mature or studio-styled specimens and are not a guarantee that the delivered specimen will be visually identical. Availability depends on the delivery city and on live vendor stock, so a listing may be withdrawn between browsing and confirmation.

Plant appearance and natural variation

Expected and not treated as defects: height differences within the listed grade band, differing leaf counts and canopy shape, seasonal colour intensity, minor cosmetic blemishes, soil settling in transit, and limited leaf drop that recovers after acclimatisation. Treated as defects and covered by a claim: wilting, rot or dieback, live pest or disease, broken stems or roots, root-bound or bare-rooted stock sold as potted, wrong species, variety or grade, damaged pots, and material dead on arrival. Claims on Live Goods must be raised within {{live_plant_claim_window}} with unboxing evidence.

Pricing, tax and payment

Prices are in Indian Rupees and inclusive of GST unless stated otherwise; a tax invoice is issued within {{gst_invoice_timeline}}. Payment is collected through Razorpay, or by cash on delivery where offered for that address and cart. Shipping is charged at checkout and waived above {{free_shipping_threshold}}. The price shown on the order confirmation governs the sale; where an obvious pricing error is detected, PlantAtHome will contact the customer and may cancel with a full refund.

Order lifecycle windows

EventApplicable window
Customer cancellation before dispatch{{cancellation_window}}
Return request, non-living goods{{return_request_window}}
Live Goods condition claim{{live_plant_claim_window}}
Submission of photo or video evidence for replacement{{replacement_evidence_window}}
Refund decision after evidence review{{refund_approval_sla}}
Refund credited to the original payment method{{refund_processing_time}}
Delivery, hyperlocal serviceable city{{delivery_sla_hyperlocal}}
Delivery, pan-India courier{{delivery_sla_courier}}

Offers, content and conduct

Promotional codes are single-use per customer unless stated, cannot be combined, and are void on cancelled or abusively returned orders. All PlantAtHome trademarks, photography, care content and catalogue data remain the property of Silvestrix Green LLP and may not be scraped, resold or republished. Customers must not misuse the platform through fraudulent payments, bot access, false claims, resale of subsidised stock, or abuse of staff, riders or vendors. Payment gateways, courier partners, mapping and messaging providers operate under their own terms, and PlantAtHome is not responsible for their independent acts. To the extent permitted by law, PlantAtHome's liability for any order is limited to the amount paid for that order; nothing here limits rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Procedures

Place an order by confirming the delivery pincode, cart and payment method; acceptance arrives by WhatsApp, email or SMS. To cancel, use the order screen or contact support within {{cancellation_window}}. To raise a defect or Live Goods claim, open the order, select the item, and upload the unboxing evidence; support triages the claim, confirms with the fulfilling vendor where relevant, and records a replacement or refund decision. Unresolved matters escalate through {{escalation_timeline}} to the grievance officer named on the PlantAtHome website. PlantAtHome may amend these Terms; the version in force at order confirmation applies to that order.

Exceptions

Made-to-order, custom-potted, corporate-branded and bulk gifting items may be non-cancellable once production starts, as stated on the listing. Seasonal and perishable FarmBox items follow shorter claim handling defined in the Configuration. Any goodwill deviation from these Terms requires approval within {{approval_limit_refund}} and must be recorded against the order.

Compliance

These Terms are drafted to operate consistently with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, the Information Technology Act, 2000, applicable GST law, and India's data protection framework as it applies to PlantAtHome. Legal counsel must confirm this alignment before publication. These Terms are governed by Indian law, with courts at the registered office of Silvestrix Green LLP having jurisdiction. This document is reviewed at {{review_frequency_default}} and on any material change to law or fulfilment model.

Violations

Fraudulent claims, chargeback abuse, credential sharing and platform misuse may result in refusal of future orders, account suspension, withholding of refunds pending investigation, recovery of losses and referral to law enforcement. Employees and vendors who override these Terms without recorded approval are handled under the applicable internal disciplinary or vendor penalty process.

Related Documents

  • Shipping Policy
  • Return, Replacement and Refund Policy
  • Live Plant Health and Replacement Policy
  • Privacy Policy
  • Customer Support and Grievance Redressal Policy

title: Shipping Policy
related_titles: Live Plant Health and Replacement Policy
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Purpose

This policy explains how PlantAtHome, a brand of Silvestrix Green LLP, ships live plants, gardening tools, pots and planters, seeds, fertilizers, accessories, FarmBox fresh produce and corporate gifting orders across India — which delivery method applies where, what a customer must do to receive an order, and what happens when a delivery is delayed, refused or fails.

Scope

Applies to every dispatch against a confirmed PlantAtHome order, whether shipped from PlantAtHome's own stock or by an approved nursery vendor, and to both hyperlocal rider delivery in serviceable cities and pan-India courier delivery elsewhere. It covers customer-facing shipping commitments only; internal carrier selection and rate cards sit in the Configuration.

Definitions

  • Serviceable city — a city where PlantAtHome operates hyperlocal rider delivery, as listed in the currently approved Serviceability Configuration.
  • Hyperlocal delivery — same-day or scheduled-slot delivery by a rider partner within a serviceable city.
  • Courier delivery — pan-India delivery through a registered logistics partner against an air waybill.
  • Live Goods — plants, saplings, cuttings, bulbs and FarmBox produce, being perishable living material.
  • Proof of delivery — the OTP, signature or rider-captured photograph recorded against the shipment at handover.
  • RTO — return to origin, where an undelivered shipment is sent back to PlantAtHome or the fulfilling vendor.

Policy Statement

PlantAtHome ships only to addresses its checkout confirms as serviceable for the specific cart, because Live Goods cannot travel every lane safely. Delivery timelines quoted at checkout are estimates based on the destination, the fulfilment source and the selected method; they are made in good faith and are not guaranteed dates. PlantAtHome will keep the customer informed at every status change and will not treat a customer as unavailable without a recorded delivery attempt.

Responsibilities

  • Customer — a complete address with landmark, a reachable phone number, society or gate access, and someone present to accept Live Goods.
  • Fulfilment and vendor operations — accepting orders within {{vendor_acceptance_sla}}, dispatching within {{vendor_dispatch_sla}}, and packing to the approved packing standard.
  • Logistics — carrier selection, lane suitability for Live Goods, and monitoring of exceptions and RTOs.
  • Customer support — proactive notification of delays and responses within {{support_response_sla}}.

Policy Requirements

Delivery methods

MethodWhere it appliesEstimated timelineLive Goods
Hyperlocal same-day riderServiceable cities, within cut-off, per Serviceability Configuration{{delivery_sla_hyperlocal}}Preferred method
Hyperlocal scheduled slotServiceable cities, customer-selected slot{{delivery_sla_hyperlocal}} from the selected slot dateSuitable
Pan-India courierNon-serviceable pincodes accepted at checkout{{delivery_sla_courier}}Only for categories cleared for courier transit
Vendor direct dispatchVendor-fulfilled orders, either lane{{vendor_dispatch_sla}} to hand-off, then the lane timeline aboveAs per the lane used

Charges

Shipping is calculated at checkout from destination, weight, volume and method, and is shown before payment. Orders above {{free_shipping_threshold}} qualify for free standard shipping where the Configuration permits it for that category. Cash-on-delivery handling charges, packaging surcharges for oversized planters and remote-area courier surcharges apply as per the currently approved Shipping Rate Configuration. Expedited or slot-specific hyperlocal delivery may carry an additional fee shown at checkout.

Tracking and customer availability

Order confirmation, dispatch, out-for-delivery and delivery events are sent over WhatsApp Business API, email and SMS, with a live tracking link for hyperlocal orders and the carrier waybill for courier orders. The customer must remain reachable on the registered number during the delivery window. PlantAtHome will make up to {{delivery_attempts}} delivery attempts. Proof of delivery is captured at handover, and a delivery completed against a valid proof of delivery is treated as fulfilled.

Live Goods shipping

Live Goods are packed to restrain the root ball, protect the canopy and vent the carton, and are dispatched against cut-offs that avoid an avoidable weekend or holiday in courier transit. In extreme heat, cold or heavy rain, dispatch may be held a short period to protect the plant; the customer is informed when this happens. Live Goods must be unboxed on arrival, and any condition claim raised within {{live_plant_claim_window}} with unboxing evidence, as set out in the Live Plant Health and Replacement Policy.

Delays and disruption

Weather events, festival and election restrictions, strikes, civic curfews, carrier network failures and other force majeure circumstances can extend timelines beyond the estimates above. PlantAtHome will notify affected customers, prioritise rescheduling of Live Goods held in transit, and where an order cannot be delivered in a condition fit for sale, will cancel and refund it within {{refund_processing_time}} of approval without requiring a return.

Incorrect address and failed delivery

Address corrections requested before dispatch are made free of charge. After dispatch, a correction depends on carrier capability and may require RTO and re-dispatch, with re-shipping charged. If delivery fails after {{delivery_attempts}} because the customer is unreachable, refuses handover without a recorded defect, or the address is incorrect or inaccessible, the shipment is returned to origin and refunded per the Return, Replacement and Refund Policy, with shipping and Live Goods spoilage deductions applied as defined there.

Procedures

Check serviceability by entering the delivery pincode before checkout. Track an order from the order screen or the tracking link in the notification. To change an address or reschedule a slot, contact support before the dispatch notification. To report a delay, missing shipment or damaged package, raise a support ticket with the order number and packaging photographs; support verifies the carrier scan record, arranges re-attempt, re-dispatch or refund, and records the outcome on the order.

Exceptions

Oversized planters, bulk landscaping consignments, corporate gifting drops to multiple recipient addresses and institutional deliveries are quoted and scheduled individually and are not bound by the standard timelines above. FarmBox produce ships only on the harvest and route days published for that city. Any waiver of shipping charges or additional free re-dispatch outside this policy requires approval within {{approval_limit_refund}}.

Compliance

This policy is drafted to operate consistently with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 disclosure requirements on delivery timelines and charges, applicable GST documentation duties, and carrier and plant-movement rules that apply to the lanes used. Legal counsel must confirm this alignment before publication. Delivery performance, RTO rates and exception handling are reviewed at {{review_frequency_default}}.

Violations

Repeated refusal of delivered shipments, false non-delivery claims or misuse of free-shipping thresholds may lead to prepayment-only checkout, withdrawal of cash on delivery, or account suspension under the Terms and Conditions. Vendors and carriers who miss dispatch or delivery commitments are handled under {{penalty_schedule}}.

Related Documents

  • Terms and Conditions
  • Return, Replacement and Refund Policy
  • Live Plant Health and Replacement Policy
  • Customer Support and Grievance Redressal Policy

title: Return Policy
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Purpose

This policy defines when a PlantAtHome customer may return a purchased item, what product condition and evidence are required, and how return requests are assessed, collected and closed. It exists because PlantAtHome sells categories with materially different return economics — living plants that continue to deteriorate after dispatch, perishable FarmBox produce, and durable goods such as pots, tools and accessories. A single undifferentiated rule would be either unfair to customers or unsustainable for the business and its nursery vendors.

Scope

This policy applies to all orders placed on the PlantAtHome website, mobile app and assisted or corporate channels for delivery within India, whether fulfilled from PlantAtHome inventory or by an approved nursery vendor, and whether delivered by hyperlocal rider or pan-India courier. It binds Customer Support, Fulfilment and Warehouse QC, Vendor Operations, Finance, and every vendor operating under the Vendor Partnership Agreement. Refund calculation and disbursement are governed by the Refund Policy; pre-delivery order cancellation is governed by the Cancellation Policy.

Definitions

  • Return — physical recovery of a delivered item from the customer, followed by inspection and a refund, replacement or rejection decision.
  • Live Plant Claim — a report that a plant arrived dead, broken, severely wilted, pest-infested or materially different from the listing.
  • Reverse Pickup — collection of the item from the delivery address by a PlantAtHome rider or courier partner.
  • Evidence — customer-supplied photographs or video showing the item, the damage or defect claimed, and the shipping label or outer packaging.
  • Sealed Condition — manufacturer or PlantAtHome seal, batch label and tamper tape intact and unopened.
  • Non-Returnable Item — an item excluded from physical return under the Policy Requirements below.

Policy Statement

PlantAtHome accepts returns for items that are damaged, defective, incorrect, incomplete or not as described, and for eligible unused durable goods, provided the request is raised within {{return_request_window}} of delivery and the category rules below are met. Live plants and FarmBox perishables are handled as claims with evidence rather than as open-ended returns, because their condition cannot be preserved in transit. Every decision is recorded against the order so the customer, the vendor and Finance see the same outcome.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support — logs the request, verifies evidence completeness, and responds within {{support_response_sla}}.
  • Fulfilment and QC — inspects returned goods, records condition against the claim, and releases or rejects the return.
  • Vendor Operations — routes vendor-fulfilled returns to the originating nursery and tracks vendor return rates against {{vendor_return_rate_threshold}}.
  • Finance — issues the GST credit note and initiates refunds per the Refund Policy.
  • Vendor — accepts reverse-pickup consignments and bears cost where the fault is attributable to the vendor under the approved {{penalty_schedule}}.
  • Customer — reports within the applicable window, supplies evidence, and keeps the item and its packaging available until collection.

Policy Requirements

CategoryRequest windowCondition requiredEvidence requiredDefault resolution
Live plants{{live_plant_claim_window}}Plant, pot and soil retained as received; no repotting, pruning or fertilising before assessmentUnboxing photographs or video, plus a clear image of the whole plant and the shipping labelReplacement where stock and season permit; refund where it does not
Pots and planters{{return_request_window}}Unused, unplanted, original packaging and protective material intactPhotographs of the breakage or defect and of the outer cartonReplacement or refund
Gardening tools{{return_request_window}}Unused, all parts and manuals present; warranty seals unbrokenPhotographs of the fault plus batch or serial markingReplacement, manufacturer warranty referral, or refund
Accessories, seeds, soil and fertilisers{{return_request_window}}Sealed Condition only; opened consumables are non-returnablePhotographs of the intact seal, batch code and expiry markingReplacement or refund
FarmBox perishablesAs per the currently approved FarmBox Freshness ConfigurationNo physical return; quality assessed on evidence at or near deliveryPhotographs taken on the day of delivery showing the affected produceRefund or credit for the affected portion

Items excluded from return in all cases: customised, engraved or made-to-order products; corporate gifting orders assembled to a client brief; plants that have been repotted, planted out or propagated; opened seed packets, fertilisers and pesticides; clearance items listed as final sale; and items damaged by customer handling, over-watering, neglect or unsuitable placement after delivery.

Procedures

  1. The customer raises a request from the order page or through an approved channel listed in {{support_channels}}, selecting the item and reason.
  2. Support validates the request against the category window and confirms that the required evidence is attached; incomplete evidence is chased once, and the claim closes if not completed within {{replacement_evidence_window}}.
  3. Support approves, rejects or escalates within {{support_resolution_sla}}. Rejections state the specific rule relied upon.
  4. For approved returns of physical goods, reverse pickup is scheduled to the delivery address; the customer keeps the item packed and available for {{delivery_attempts}} collection attempts.
  5. QC inspects on receipt and records condition. A mismatch between the claim and the inspected item is escalated rather than silently refunded.
  6. On a clear inspection, Finance issues the credit note and the refund or replacement proceeds under the Refund Policy.
  7. Vendor-attributable returns are posted against the vendor ledger for the next {{vendor_settlement_cycle}}.

Exceptions

Exceptions to windows, evidence or condition requirements may be granted where a delivery delay, courier mishandling or serviceability failure caused the condition complained of, or as a goodwill resolution within {{approval_limit_refund}}. Every exception must be recorded on the order with the approver's name and reason. Exceptions above that limit require the approval of the Head of Customer Experience together with Finance.

Compliance

This policy is written to operate consistently with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, including the requirement to disclose return conditions before purchase and to not refuse a return for goods delivered defective, deficient or not matching the listing. Tax documentation follows applicable GST rules, with credit notes raised against the original invoice. Personal data collected during a return, including evidence images, is retained for {{data_retention_period}}. This policy is reviewed at {{review_frequency_default}}.

Violations

Return abuse — repeated claims without supportable evidence, returning a substituted or used item, claiming non-delivery on a confirmed delivery, or coordinated claim patterns across accounts and addresses — may result in withdrawal of prepaid-free-return handling, restriction to prepaid payment, refusal of future claims, account suspension, and recovery of amounts already refunded. Staff who approve returns outside their authority, or vendors who refuse valid reverse pickups, are handled under the applicable internal disciplinary process or the {{penalty_schedule}} in the Vendor Partnership Agreement.

Related Documents

  • Refund Policy
  • Cancellation Policy
  • Shipping and Delivery Policy
  • Vendor Partnership Agreement
  • Customer Support and Escalation Policy

title: Refund Policy
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Purpose

This policy sets out when PlantAtHome, a brand of Silvestrix Green LLP, refunds money to a customer, how much is refunded, who approves it, by what method it is paid, and how long it takes. It also defines how promotional discounts, gift cards, shipping charges and failed payments are treated, so that customers, Support agents and Finance apply the same arithmetic to the same order.

Scope

This policy covers every refund arising from an order placed on the PlantAtHome website, mobile app or assisted and corporate channels for delivery within India, including prepaid and cash-on-delivery orders, hyperlocal and courier deliveries, and orders fulfilled by approved nursery vendors. Eligibility to return goods is governed by the Return Policy; the right to cancel before delivery is governed by the Cancellation Policy. This policy governs only the money.

Definitions

  • Full Refund — the full amount paid for the affected items, including any shipping charged on those items.
  • Partial Refund — a refund of part of the order value, calculated on the affected items only.
  • Original Method — the payment instrument used at checkout, refunded through the payment gateway.
  • Store Credit — non-withdrawable credit issued to the customer's PlantAtHome account.
  • Gateway Delay — the period between PlantAtHome initiating a refund and the customer's bank or card issuer posting it.
  • Reapportioned Discount — an order-level promotional discount redistributed across items so that a partial refund does not return the discounted portion twice.

Policy Statement

PlantAtHome refunds customers where an order is cancelled before dispatch, where a delivery fails, where a payment is captured in error or duplicated, or where a return or claim is approved under the Return Policy. Where an item is available and the customer accepts it, a replacement is offered before a refund, because replacement preserves the customer's original intent and avoids reverse-logistics waste on living goods. A customer who declines replacement is refunded and is not required to accept a substitute plant, pot or variety.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support — determines eligibility, computes the refundable amount, and approves within {{approval_limit_refund}}.
  • Finance — approves amounts above that limit, issues the GST credit note, verifies bank details for COD refunds, and reconciles gateway settlements.
  • Fulfilment and QC — confirms receipt and condition of returned goods before a refund is released.
  • Vendor Operations — recovers vendor-attributable refunds through the {{vendor_settlement_cycle}}.
  • Risk and Fraud Review — holds refunds flagged by the approved risk checks pending investigation.

Policy Requirements

ScenarioRefund typeApprovalMethodInitiation
Cancellation before processingFull, including shippingAutomatic within {{cancellation_window}}Original MethodWithin {{refund_approval_sla}}
Approved return of a delivered itemFull or partial on the affected items, discount reapportionedSupport within {{approval_limit_refund}}; Finance above itOriginal MethodAfter QC clearance, within {{refund_approval_sla}}
Live plant or FarmBox claim approvedReplacement offered first; refund if declined or unavailableSupport within {{approval_limit_refund}}Original Method or Store Credit at customer's choiceWithin {{refund_approval_sla}} of evidence acceptance
Delivery failed after {{delivery_attempts}}Item value refunded; shipping treated as per the currently approved Shipping Charges ConfigurationFulfilment plus SupportOriginal MethodOn return of goods to origin

All approved refunds are disbursed within {{refund_processing_time}} from approval. Amounts paid using a gift card or Store Credit are returned to the same balance and are not converted to cash. Gift cards themselves are not refundable for cash once issued, except where required by law or where the card was issued in error. Free-gift and threshold-based benefits, including any benefit earned by crossing {{free_shipping_threshold}}, are recalculated on partial refunds and the unearned benefit is deducted.

Procedures

  1. Support confirms the triggering event — cancellation, return approval, claim approval, delivery failure or payment exception — and links it to the order.
  2. The refundable amount is computed on the affected items with the order-level discount reapportioned, taxes adjusted, and any unearned shipping or gift benefit removed.
  3. Approval is recorded against {{approval_limit_refund}}, with Finance countersigning above it.
  4. Finance raises the credit note against the original tax invoice within {{gst_invoice_timeline}}.
  5. The refund is initiated to the Original Method; the customer is notified over WhatsApp, email or SMS with the reference identifier.
  6. Gateway settlement is reconciled; unposted refunds are chased with the gateway and the customer is kept informed within {{support_response_sla}}.

Exceptions

Refunds to an alternative instrument are permitted only where the original instrument is closed or unreachable, and only after identity verification by Finance. Goodwill refunds outside eligibility may be granted within {{approval_limit_refund}} and must state the reason on the order. Bulk, corporate gifting and subscription refunds follow the commercial terms of the signed contract where those terms differ from this policy.

Compliance

Refund handling is aligned to the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, and to the refund timelines directed by the Reserve Bank of India for the relevant payment instrument. Gateway timelines are outside PlantAtHome's control once a refund is initiated; PlantAtHome commits to initiation within {{refund_processing_time}} and to sharing the gateway reference. Escalations follow {{escalation_timeline}}. Transaction and refund records are retained for {{data_retention_period}}, and this policy is reviewed at {{review_frequency_default}}.

Violations

Refund claims found to be fraudulent — non-delivery claims on verified deliveries, chargebacks raised after a refund is received, substituted or tampered returns, or repeat claims across linked accounts — will be refused, may be reported to the payment gateway and law enforcement, and may result in account suspension and recovery of amounts already paid. Staff who split approvals to stay under {{approval_limit_refund}}, or who release refunds before QC clearance, are subject to internal disciplinary action.

title: Cancellation Policy
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Purpose

This policy defines when a PlantAtHome customer may cancel an order, what happens to an order cancelled at each stage of fulfilment, and the circumstances in which PlantAtHome itself cancels an order. It is written around the fact that cancellation cost rises sharply once a live plant has been pulled from a nursery bench, hardened, packed and handed to a rider — so the right to cancel is broad early and narrow late, and the rules must be visible before the customer pays.

Scope

This policy applies to all orders placed on the PlantAtHome website, mobile app and assisted or corporate channels for delivery within India, including prepaid and cash-on-delivery orders, hyperlocal rider and pan-India courier deliveries, direct and vendor-fulfilled orders, FarmBox subscriptions and recurring plant-care plans. The consequences of a cancellation for money already paid are governed by the Refund Policy; post-delivery recovery of goods is governed by the Return Policy.

Definitions

  • Processing — the state after an order is confirmed and before it is allocated to a fulfilment source.
  • Vendor Allocation — assignment of one or more items to an approved nursery vendor for fulfilment.
  • Packaged — the item is picked, prepared, boxed and labelled, and awaits handover.
  • Dispatched — the consignment is handed to a rider or courier partner and is in transit.
  • Customised Order — a made-to-order, engraved, potted-to-brief or corporate gifting assembly prepared for a specific customer.
  • Company-Initiated Cancellation — cancellation by PlantAtHome for the reasons set out below.

Policy Statement

A customer may cancel any standard order at no charge within {{cancellation_window}} of placing it, and may request cancellation after that point subject to the fulfilment stage reached. PlantAtHome will not levy a cancellation charge where the customer cancels before the order incurs handling cost, and will not silently convert a cancellation into a return. Where a cancellation is requested too late to stop the consignment, the request is converted to a refusal at delivery or a return request, and the customer is told which applies before the outcome is finalised.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support — accepts, verifies and records cancellation requests within {{support_response_sla}} and communicates the resulting stage-based outcome.
  • Fulfilment — attempts to intercept picking, packing or handover as soon as a request is logged.
  • Vendor Operations — notifies the allocated vendor immediately and tracks cancellations attributable to vendor breach of {{vendor_acceptance_sla}} or {{vendor_dispatch_sla}}.
  • Finance — releases refunds and credit notes under the Refund Policy.
  • Category and Inventory — cancels and reports orders that cannot be fulfilled because stock, season or serviceability fails.

Policy Requirements

Stage at time of requestCustomer cancellationCharges deductedMoney outcome
Placed, before ProcessingPermitted in full, self-serviceNoneFull refund per the Refund Policy, initiated within {{refund_approval_sla}}
After Vendor Allocation, before pickPermitted; vendor notified immediatelyNoneFull refund
Packaged and labelled, not handed overPermitted where interception succeedsHandling as per the currently approved Cancellation Charges ConfigurationRefund of the balance
Dispatched or out for deliveryNot permitted; treated as refusal at deliveryShipping as per the currently approved Shipping Charges ConfigurationRefund on return of goods to origin
Customised or corporate gifting order, after production startsNot permittedNot applicableNo refund except for defect or non-delivery
FarmBox perishables, after the cut-off in the approved Harvest Cut-off ConfigurationNot permitted for that deliveryNot applicableValue of the affected delivery is not refunded
Subscription, for future deliveriesPermitted at any time before the next cut-offNoneUnused prepaid deliveries refunded or credited

Cash-on-delivery orders may be cancelled on the same stage rules; repeated late cancellation or refusal at the door may move the customer to prepaid-only checkout.

Procedures

  1. The customer cancels from the order page, or contacts a channel listed in {{support_channels}} and states the order identifier and items to cancel.
  2. Support records the request with a timestamp — the timestamp, not the conversation, determines the stage that applies.
  3. Fulfilment or the allocated vendor attempts interception and reports success or failure to Support.
  4. Support confirms the outcome to the customer with the applicable stage rule, including any charge deducted and its source configuration.
  5. Where interception fails, the order continues and the customer is offered refusal at delivery or a return request under the Return Policy.
  6. Finance processes the resulting refund within {{refund_processing_time}} of approval.

Exceptions

PlantAtHome may cancel an order at any stage where stock or a suitable plant of the ordered grade is unavailable, the delivery address falls outside serviceable coverage, the customer cannot be reached after {{delivery_attempts}}, a pricing or listing error is identified before dispatch, a payment or risk check fails, or a force majeure event, weather condition or regulatory restriction makes safe delivery of living goods impossible. A company-initiated cancellation carries no charge to the customer and is refunded in full. Charge waivers for late customer cancellation may be granted within {{approval_limit_refund}} and must be recorded on the order.

Compliance

Cancellation terms are disclosed before payment as required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, and this policy is applied consistently across all customers and channels under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Tax adjustment on cancelled orders follows applicable GST rules within {{gst_invoice_timeline}}. Escalations follow {{escalation_timeline}}, and unresolved matters are handled through the Customer Support and Escalation Policy. This policy is reviewed at {{review_frequency_default}}.

Violations

Persistent cancellation abuse — repeated late cancellations, systematic refusal of cash-on-delivery consignments, or cancellation used to block stock — may result in restriction to prepaid payment, order-value limits, or account suspension. Vendors who force cancellations by breaching {{vendor_acceptance_sla}} or {{vendor_dispatch_sla}} are assessed against {{vendor_quality_target}} and the {{penalty_schedule}} in the Vendor Partnership Agreement. Staff who back-date a cancellation request to change the applicable stage are subject to internal disciplinary action.

title: Replacement Policy
html:
DRAFT — LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED. This document is an operational or legal draft and must be reviewed and approved by authorized management and, where required, qualified legal counsel before becoming effective.

Purpose

This policy sets out when PlantAtHome, a brand of Silvestrix Green LLP, will replace a delivered item, what evidence a customer must provide, and how a claim is assessed. It exists because living goods behave differently from manufactured ones: a plant that arrives with two yellowed lower leaves is behaving normally, while a plant that arrives with a snapped stem and a dry, detached root ball is not. The policy gives customers, support agents and nursery vendors one shared test for that difference so that outcomes are consistent across orders, cities and fulfilment routes.

Scope

Applies to all orders placed on PlantAtHome web and app channels and delivered in India, whether fulfilled from PlantAtHome inventory or by an approved nursery vendor, and whether delivered by hyperlocal rider or by pan-India courier. It covers live plants, pots and planters, gardening tools, seeds, fertilizers, accessories, FarmBox fresh produce and corporate gifting orders, and binds all support, operations, quality and vendor management staff who handle claims. It does not cover pricing disputes, delivery delays or payment failures, which are governed by the documents listed under Related Documents.

Definitions

  • Replacement — dispatch of the same item, or an approved equivalent, at no further cost to the customer, in place of the item originally delivered.
  • Dead on arrival (DOA) — a live plant that is non-viable at the moment of delivery: collapsed or mushy stem, fully desiccated foliage and root ball, or the odour of root rot, evident before any customer care has begun.
  • Transit damage — physical damage caused between dispatch and delivery, such as cracked ceramic, a shattered planter, a crushed carton, a broken tool housing, or soil entirely spilled from the nursery bag.
  • Quality failure — a defect in the product itself: pest infestation present at delivery, disease, the wrong species or size grade, or a tool that fails on first correct use.
  • Natural plant variation — differences inherent to a living organism grown in a nursery, which are not defects.
  • Unboxing evidence — a continuous, unedited video of the sealed package being opened, together with photographs of the item, the shipping label and the outer packaging.

Policy Statement

PlantAtHome will replace an item where the customer raises a claim within the applicable window, supplies the required evidence, and the defect is attributable to the product, its packing or its transit rather than to natural plant variation or post-delivery handling. Where a replacement is unavailable, the customer is offered an approved alternative of equivalent value or a refund. Claim windows, evidence rules and approval thresholds are held in the currently approved Replacement Configuration and are not restated in this document.

Responsibilities

RoleAccountability
Customer SupportLogs the claim, checks evidence completeness, responds within {{support_response_sla}} and closes within {{support_resolution_sla}}
Quality and OperationsAdjudicates contested claims and rules on variation versus failure
Vendor ManagementRecovers cost from the fulfilling vendor under {{commission_model}} and {{penalty_schedule}}; monitors {{vendor_return_rate_threshold}}
FinanceIssues refunds within {{refund_processing_time}}; obtains approval above {{approval_limit_refund}}
CustomerSubmits evidence within the claim window and retains the item until a decision is issued

Policy Requirements

Eligible situations

SituationApplies toEvidence requiredClaim window
Dead on arrivalLive plantsUnboxing video plus photographs of the whole plant and the root ball{{live_plant_claim_window}}
Pest or disease present at deliveryLive plantsClose-range photographs of affected foliage, stem and soil surface{{live_plant_claim_window}}
Transit damagePots, planters, ceramics, glass, toolsUnboxing video plus photographs of the outer carton and the damaged item{{replacement_evidence_window}}
Incorrect product deliveredAll categoriesPhotographs of the item received and of the shipping label{{return_request_window}}
Missing item or short shipmentAll categoriesUnboxing video showing the full package contents{{replacement_evidence_window}}
Quality failure on first useTools, electricals, accessoriesPhotographs or video showing the fault, with the invoice referenceAs per the currently approved Replacement Configuration
Spoiled produceFarmBoxPhotographs of the affected produce on the day of deliveryAs per the currently approved Replacement Configuration

Natural variation, which is not replaceable

  • Height, leaf count or bushiness differing from the catalogue photograph while remaining within the listed size grade.
  • Minor differences in variegation pattern, leaf shape or colour intensity between individual plants of the same species.
  • Two or three yellowed or shed lower leaves, or temporary drooping, after transit that recovers with watering and acclimatisation.
  • Soil settled below the pot rim, or surface algae and moss on the growing medium.
  • Hairline surface variation, tonal difference or kiln marks in handmade terracotta and stoneware.
  • Absence of flowers or fruit on a plant listed and sold for foliage, or outside its flowering season.

Quality failure, which is replaceable

  • Stem snapped below the growing point, or the plant separated from its root ball.
  • Root ball bone-dry and shrunken, or waterlogged and rotting with an odour, at unboxing.
  • Visible colonies of mealybug, scale, spider mite or fungal lesions across most of the foliage at unboxing.
  • A species or cultivar different from the one ordered, or a pot size below the grade purchased.
  • A pot cracked through its wall or base, or a tool whose blade will not close or whose motor will not start on first correct use.

Procedures

  1. The customer raises the claim through {{support_channels}} within the window in the table above and uploads the required evidence.
  2. Support acknowledges within {{support_response_sla}} and requests any missing evidence once; unanswered evidence requests close the claim, which the customer may reopen within the same window.
  3. Support classifies the claim as natural variation or quality failure. Contested cases go to Quality and Operations for a ruling within {{support_resolution_sla}}.
  4. For vendor-fulfilled orders, the vendor is asked to confirm within {{vendor_acceptance_sla}}; if the vendor does not respond, the claim is decided without them and cost recovery follows separately.
  5. Approved claims are dispatched as replacements within {{vendor_dispatch_sla}} and delivered within {{delivery_sla_hyperlocal}} or {{delivery_sla_courier}} according to the serving route.
  6. Where stock is unavailable, the customer chooses an approved alternative of equivalent value or a refund to the original payment method, processed within {{refund_processing_time}} and approved per {{approval_limit_refund}} and {{refund_approval_sla}}.
  7. Reverse pickup is arranged only where the item retains resale or disposal value; live plants are usually not recovered.
  8. Declined claims are answered in writing with reasons and the escalation route, which follows {{escalation_timeline}}.
  9. Claim frequency per account and per address is scored using {{risk_scoring_model}} and reviewed at {{risk_review_frequency}}. Accounts flagged for repeat or duplicated claims lose automatic approval and require manager sign-off; edited, reused or third-party evidence is rejected.
  10. Evidence and decisions are stored against the order record and retained for {{data_retention_period}}.

Exceptions

Corporate gifting and bulk orders follow the replacement terms of the signed order contract where these differ. Goodwill replacements outside the claim window may be authorised by management within {{approval_limit_refund}}, must be recorded as goodwill, and create no precedent. Every exception is logged against the order with the approver's name.

Compliance

This policy is written to operate consistently with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, including accurate product representation and accessible grievance redressal, and does not limit any statutory right a consumer holds. Credit notes arising from replacements are raised in line with {{gst_invoice_timeline}}. The policy is reviewed at {{review_frequency_default}} and whenever claim data shows a category behaving outside {{vendor_quality_target}}.

Violations

Fabricated, edited or recycled evidence results in denial of the claim, and may lead to cancellation of pending orders, restriction of the account and recovery of amounts already refunded. Vendors whose replacement rate exceeds {{vendor_return_rate_threshold}} or who repeatedly dispute valid claims are subject to {{penalty_schedule}} and may be suspended from the catalogue. Staff who approve replacements or refunds beyond {{approval_limit_refund}}, or who bypass evidence requirements, are dealt with under internal disciplinary procedure.

Related Documents
